native_item: Inbound receive queue cost per queued event
native_cite: _Utility/Messages.cpp:887-1010 (ReceiveMessages drains the whole m_msgList on the single-owner thread; a received packet is queued per datagram at Messages.cpp:313-328 with no per-peer event or byte bound)
native_rule: Native bounds inbound work only by draining the whole message list once per frame; there is no per-peer byte or event reservation at all
port_cite_or_reason: src/Allegiance.Server/ServerHost.cs (EnqueueReceive charges payload + PerEventOverheadBytes; MaxQueuedEventsPerPeer caps un-handled events; ReleaseReservation releases both; RemovePeerAccounting retires both) — a deliberate port bound (P315/P1023), not a native rule
evidence: tests/Allegiance.Core.Tests/R1ReviewTests.cs Tiny_frames_from_one_peer_cannot_queue_without_bound; tests/Allegiance.Core.Tests/Transport/P1023InboundQueueAndDeadlinesTests.cs (CRC-only cost, zero-length cost, event-cap boundary, release, 200-peer cadence); report docs/reports/R1_TRANSPORT_LIMITS_P1023.md

native_item: Empty or short packet on the wire
native_cite: FedSrv/FedSrv.CPP:4591-4603 (OnBadCRC deletes the connection); Inc/messagecore.h:431-438 (PacketSize = m_dwcbPacket - sizeof(int), a DWORD subtraction); _Utility/Messages.cpp:934-935 (CRC compare at that size); FedSrv.CPP:4599 (bad-CRC log guards cbMsg >= 2/4)
native_rule: Native has no length guard: a packet shorter than the CRC slot underflows PacketSize, the CRC compare fails and the connection is deleted (a short packet is expected to reach the guard)
port_cite_or_reason: src/Allegiance.Core/Transport/TcpTransport.cs ReadDataLoop: a data frame shorter than FedPacket.CrcWidth is a protocol error -> DropPeer(BadCrc); the dispatch layer already used the same reason for the same condition (Server.Dispatch.cs:42)
evidence: tests/Allegiance.Core.Tests/Transport/P1023InboundQueueAndDeadlinesTests.cs P1023ShortDataFrameThreadPerPeerTests/P1023ShortDataFramePoolTests (zero-length and 2-byte frames drop the peer with BadCrc; a 4-byte CRC-only packet is still delivered); docs/reports/R1_TRANSPORT_LIMITS_P1023.md

native_cite: clintlib.cpp:2047 (g_sDeadTime = 30 s); clintlib.cpp:2063-2064 (client link-dead check: unanswered pings and no server message for g_sDeadTime)
native_rule: Native's DirectPlay connect has no greeting handshake; the only liveness rule is the CLIENT-side 30 s ping watchdog, so the peer must complete its framing inside one deadline
port_cite_or_reason: src/Allegiance.Core/Transport/TcpTransport.cs HandlePeer passes one ABSOLUTE deadline (accept + GreetTimeout) to ReadFrame for the whole greeting (idle and in-progress frame), instead of a per-read socket ReceiveTimeout
evidence: tests/Allegiance.Core.Tests/R1ReviewTests.cs A_dribbled_greeting_is_dropped_at_the_greet_timeout; tests/Allegiance.Core.Tests/Transport/TcpTransportGreetTimeoutTests.cs (silent staller, oversized claim, joined-but-idle peer); docs/reports/R1_TRANSPORT_LIMITS_P1023.md

native_cite: FedSrv/FedSrv.CPP:4536-4544 (FedSrvSiteBase::OnNewConnection: a debug log and 'we don't do anything until they login')
native_rule: Native keeps a connected, never-logged-in peer indefinitely: OnNewConnection has no timer and only the client-side ping watchdog notices a dead link
port_cite_or_reason: src/Allegiance.Server/Server.Lifecycle.cs SweepPreLogonConnections + transport.preLogonTimeoutSeconds (default 60, 0 disables; ALLEGIANCE_TRANSPORT_PRELOGON_TIMEOUT_SECONDS); deliberate port hardening because the data-link idle bound only sees silence and a valid-frame trickle restarts it
evidence: tests/Allegiance.Core.Tests/Transport/P1023InboundQueueAndDeadlinesTests.cs P1023PreLogonTimeoutTests (kept forever with the deadline off; dropped at the deadline; a logged-on peer never cut); report docs/reports/R1_TRANSPORT_LIMITS_P1023.md
